Package info.openrocket.core.simulation.motorbatch

Class MotorBatchRunner

java.lang.Object
info.openrocket.core.simulation.motorbatch.MotorBatchRunner
public final class MotorBatchRunner extends Object
Bounded candidate-level parallelism: no worker ever reads another worker's rocket or flight data.
